credential_policy: Settings UI credentials are process-memory only. Environment and ignored LocalConfig credentials remain supported for development.
fallback_policy: Invalid configuration, missing credentials, transport errors, non-2xx responses, malformed output, or validation failures always return the deterministic local decision.
notes: Provider, BaseURL, model, and enabled state may be saved locally. API keys entered in the game are never written to ini, logs, saves, or this file.
